## 1. Identity
- Stack entry `L8dff280f.BRP90`, NY PM (session code 4, ET 12:00-16:00). Cell: row `tm180`, module `trig_confluence_user` (code/th_grid/trig_confluence_user.py; combiner triggers_b/confl_b.py; members triggers_b/combos.py:5-10), variant `u3a`, params {"k": 2, "w": 1}, mode both. Events file /mnt/l2/l2vast/_brkt/ev/L8dff280f_R0_P90.parquet (1,769 events: 857 long, 912 short; stop_pts = tgt_pts = 90.0, lots 1 on every row, checked); engine base set TL3_ALN_NP_L8dff280f_R0BRP90.
- Entries per day (signals): mean 2.30, median 2, p90 4, max 7 over 768 days; last 20 days mean 2.45. Sample days: 20261027 = 1 signal, 20261110 = 2 signals.

## 2. Bar: tm180 (3-minute epoch-aligned time bar)
Code: engine own time-bar store /mnt/l2/l2vast/_major_sw/tbars/tm180/ (code/th_swap/common.py row_dir, th_swap/tbars.py), rule D8_BAR_DEFS.md 3.1 / section 8.
- bucket = floor(record UTC seconds / 180): boundaries every 3 minutes of the clock (:00, :03, ... of each hour); every tape RECORD counts (time bars are not affected by the D8 print rule); o/h/l/c = first / max / min / last record, volume = sum of sizes; no bar for an empty bucket; ONE continuous series over all sessions (the indicators carry state across sessions and days). A bar belongs to the session of its NOMINAL END time; known time = max(nominal end, timestamp of the first record of the next existing bucket); part = 1 only for a truncated last bar of a session (never signals).
- NY PM bars = nominal end 12:00:00, 12:03, ..., 15:57 ET = 80 bars (the bar ending 16:00:00 ET belongs to code 5). The bars are NOT back-adjusted at contract rolls (tm rows carry no instrument id, D8_TRIGGER_DEFS.md 1.5).
- VERIFIED: td 20261027 and td 20261110: rebuilt from the tape, 80 of 80 NY PM bars equal.
- No daily scale for this row (no threshold, no s_vol/s_n/s_rng): the "input tables for 45 days" of the volume books do not apply; the day-by-day input is the indicator state (section 6).

## 3. Trigger: confluence u3a = 2 of 3 votes {squeeze fire, MACD signal cross, CCI zero cross}, w = 1 bar (same bar)
Code: code/th_grid/triggers_b/confl_b.py:42-60 (`last_vote`, `group_sig`, `combine`, `make_signal_fn`), combos.py:5-10 (members), impl_um.py (indicators), core.py (ema, sma, rstd, edge, out). One continuous series of all stored tm180 bars; every indicator is computed over the whole series from its first bar.
3.1 Member votes (each is a signal of +1 / -1 / 0 per bar; w = 1 means a vote counts on the bar it occurs only):
- SQUEEZE `fire` (len 20, kc 1.5), impl_um.py:7-21: m = SMA(close, 20); sd = rolling population std (ddof 0) of close over 20; atrs = SMA(TR, 20) where TR = max(h-l, |h-prev c|, |l-prev c|) (first bar h-l; SIMPLE moving average of TR, not Wilder); mid = EMA(close, 20) (alpha 2/21, seeded with the first close); squeeze_on = (m + 2 sd < mid + 1.5 atrs) AND (m - 2 sd > mid - 1.5 atrs) (strict); hist = value at the last point of the least-squares line over the last 20 points of x = close - (((max high20 + min low20) / 2) + m) / 2 (windows include the current bar); fire = squeeze_on on the previous bar AND NOT squeeze_on now; vote +1 if fire and hist > 0, -1 if fire and hist < 0, else 0. NaN until 20 bars.
- MACD `sigcross` (12, 26, 9), impl_um.py:34-48: macd = EMA12(close) - EMA26(close); signal = EMA9(macd) (every EMA alpha = 2/(n+1), seeded with the first value); long condition macd > signal, short condition macd < signal; EDGE (core.py:63-70): vote +1 on the bar where the long condition is true and was false (not-long) on the previous bar, -1 mirrored; both true cannot happen; the first 35 bars (s + g = 26 + 9) are forced to 0.
- CCI `zero` (len 14), impl_um.py:56-76: tp = (h + l + c) / 3; ma = mean of tp over 14; md = mean absolute deviation of tp from ma over 14; cci = (tp - ma) / (0.015 md) (0 if md = 0), NaN for the first 13 bars; vote +1 if cci > 0 and previous cci <= 0; -1 if cci < 0 and previous cci >= 0 (NaN comparisons false).
3.2 Combination (confl_b.py:53-60): cl = number of long votes, cs = number of short votes (each of the three members is its own group). Long condition = cl >= 2 AND cl > cs; short = cs >= 2 AND cs > cl; then the EDGE of core.py:63-70 (signal only on the first bar where the condition becomes true; the condition is evaluated on the previous bar, which with w = 1 means a 2-of-3 on consecutive bars gives one signal); part = 1 bars give no signal and the first bar of the series none (core.py:56-61). Sides both. Signal bar must be code 4 with part = 0.
3.3 Warm-up: the series is the whole stored history (since 2023-04); the longest memory is the EMA26/EMA9 chain (MACD forced 0 for 35 bars) and the 20-bar windows; EMAs seeded from the first close of the series have forgotten the seed long before the sample days. A chart that starts fresh needs enough completed bars for the EMA chain to converge (NOT tested here how many; engine seeds the EMAs from the first bar of a 3-year series); exact reproduction of the engine needs the same series start (differences decay).
VERIFIED: engine module = events 1,769 / 1,769; own implementation = 1,769 / 1,769.

## 4. Data NT8 needs
NQ trades only (3-minute epoch-aligned time bars from tick timestamps, OHLC and volume). No aggressor side, no depth, no second symbol. Risk: bar boundary jitter (NT8 clock vs record timestamps, D8_BAR_DEFS.md section 8), close timing (known = first tick of the next bucket).

## 5. Bracket, sides, window, one position
- Bracket 90.0 stop / 90.0 target points from the entry fill, fixed, 1 lot, no unit rule. Sides both. Window NY PM bars as in section 2; exit 16:00 ET + 1 s.
**Signal to engine event (VERIFIED in code).** Event time = floor(known time of the signal bar to whole seconds) + 2 s (code/th_nyeng/ny_build.py:32); events with ts >= the session-end instant are dropped (ny_build.py:33); session-end instant = next ET boundary after the signal bar (code/th_swap/common.py:32-40; NY PM = 16:00 ET: 21:00:00Z in EST, 20:00:00Z in EDT); exit cap N = 120 s (code/th_fakefill/cap_exit.py). Only bars of session code 4 (nominal end 12:00 ... 15:57 ET) with part = 0 can signal. **One-position / fill / exits (text of D8_BUILD_SPEC.md (b2), simulator code/replica/sim.py, NOT re-verified here).** MARKET order at event time, filled 1.0 s later walking the 10-level book; stop = stop order at fill -/+ 90 pts, target = resting limit at fill +/- 90 pts; ONE position per book (an event while in a trade / exit pending / entry in flight is dropped); scheduled exit 16:00 ET + 1.0 s (120 s last-print rule); roll: flat 1 ns before the roll second, entries skipped roll-120 s to roll+300 s. 1 lot per book in the engine runs (bare R0).
